title: SAMPLE: The Coffee Pot (replace with your story)
style_block: warm hand-painted illustration, soft golden-hour light, muted earth palette, gentle film grain

characters.description: a fictional Ethiopian grandmother in her seventies, white netela shawl, kind lined face, silver hair in a braid

voice.style: calm, warm and unhurried, like telling a story to a grandchild

cues.caption: gentle krar and soft strings, warm and nostalgic, sparse texture, no lead melody

shots.purpose: Establish the village at dawn so the viewer knows where we are

keyframe.prompt: a small highland village at dawn, round houses with smoke rising, eucalyptus trees, mist in the valley

motion.prompt: the camera pushes in slowly, mist drifts across the valley

narration.text: Every morning, before the sun cleared the hills, my grandmother lit the fire.
narration.subtitle: Every morning, before the sun cleared the hills, my grandmother lit the fire.

shots.purpose: Introduce the grandmother and her ritual

keyframe.prompt: an elderly woman in a white shawl kneeling by a small charcoal stove inside a round house, warm firelight

motion.prompt: she fans the coals gently, sparks rise, the camera stays still

narration.text: She never hurried. She said coffee knows when you are impatient.
narration.subtitle: She never hurried. She said coffee knows when you are impatient.

shots.purpose: Show the craft: roasting the beans is the heart of the ceremony

keyframe.prompt: green coffee beans turning dark brown in a flat iron pan over glowing coals, thin smoke curling

motion.prompt: beans shift in the pan, smoke curls upward, slow tilt down

narration.text: The beans turned from green to gold to brown, and the whole house filled with smoke.
narration.subtitle: The beans turned from green to gold to brown, and the whole house filled with smoke.

shots.purpose: Bring the neighbours in: the ceremony is about community

keyframe.prompt: neighbours arriving at a doorway in morning light, fresh grass scattered on the floor, low wooden stools

motion.prompt: people step through the doorway, the camera pans slowly right

narration.text: The smell was an invitation. One by one, the neighbours came in.
narration.subtitle: The smell was an invitation. One by one, the neighbours came in.

shots.purpose: The pour: the motif of the clay pot

keyframe.prompt: a black clay coffee pot pouring a thin stream of coffee into small white cups on a wooden tray

motion.prompt: a thin stream of coffee pours into the cups, steam rises, camera fixed

narration.text: She poured from high above the cups, and never spilled a single drop.
narration.subtitle: She poured from high above the cups, and never spilled a single drop.

shots.purpose: Emotional centre: what the ritual really meant

keyframe.prompt: close portrait of an elderly woman smiling softly, eyes half closed, warm firelight on her face

motion.prompt: she smiles slowly, the camera pushes in gently

narration.text: Three cups, she told me. The first for talk, the second for thought, the third for blessing.
narration.subtitle: Three cups, she told me. The first for talk, the second for thought, the third for blessing.

shots.purpose: Time passes: the pot is now on a different, modern table

keyframe.prompt: the same black clay coffee pot standing alone on a modern apartment table by a window, city lights outside

motion.prompt: the camera orbits slowly around the pot, city lights flicker

narration.text: Now the pot lives with me, far from the hills.
narration.subtitle: Now the pot lives with me, far from the hills.

shots.purpose: Close the circle: the ritual continues in the next generation

keyframe.prompt: young hands roasting coffee beans in a flat pan on a small stove in a modern kitchen, morning light

motion.prompt: the hands stir the beans, smoke rises, the camera pulls back slowly

narration.text: But every Sunday, I light the fire. And I do not hurry.
narration.subtitle: But every Sunday, I light the fire. And I do not hurry.
